Product, study and population: BPZE1 adult phase IIb comparison with Tdap, NCT03942406. The study enrolled 300 adults, comprising a 20-person safety lead-in and a 280-person main cohort [bpze1_tdap2023].
Measured endpoint or proposed assessment: Mucosal and systemic immune responses. Following attenuated BPZE1 challenge on day 85, culture positivity occurred in 8/80 BPZE1 recipients and 28/40 Tdap recipients. Breakthrough colonisation after BPZE1 vaccination had lower bacterial counts and faster clearance.
Use in the present analysis: Independent human evidence that vaccination can alter detectable colonisation, burden and clearance after controlled exposure.
Quantities requiring separate estimation: Effects against wild-type exposure, the contribution of initial acquisition versus subsequent clearance, and infectiousness to contacts.

Product, study and population: BPZE1 immune follow-up in NCT03942406, the same adult trial. The day-254 analysis included 86 recipients in the BPZE1-prime/placebo-second-dose group [bpze1_adult_registry].
Measured endpoint or proposed assessment: Nasal S-IgA against whole-cell extract had a day-254 fold rise of 1.45 (95% CI 1.22–1.72). The second administration on day 85 was placebo. Results were grouped by treatment received.
Use in the present analysis: Evidence on the time course of a measured mucosal response after one BPZE1 dose.
Quantities requiring separate estimation: The relationship between this antibody response and protection against infection, onward transmission or duration of protection.

Product, study and population: BPZE1 wild-type challenge trial, NCT05461131, and its secondary immunological report. Fifty-three adults were randomised and 45 comprised the modified intention-to-treat challenge population, 24 BPZE1 and 21 placebo recipients [bpze1_challenge2025; bpze1_immune2026].
Measured endpoint or proposed assessment: After challenge 60–120 days after vaccination, no colonisation was detected on observed challenge days 9, 11 and 14 in 14/24 BPZE1 and 7/21 placebo recipients (primary comparison, $p=0.091$). The adequate-inoculum sensitivity population had 12/20 versus 4/16 culture-negative participants ($p=0.033$). The secondary report supplied participant AUC values and mucosal and cellular immune measurements. S-IgA responses in this cohort decreased towards baseline by day 52 after vaccination.
Use in the present analysis: The whole-group arithmetic AUC ratio of 0.05699 anchors the specified translation profiles. Participant resampling supplies the AUC sensitivity endpoints. Late culture positivity and burden among positives describe components of this observed contrast.
Quantities requiring separate estimation: Initial acquisition versus clearance before sampling, the relation between cultured bacterial burden and infectiousness to contacts, and protection beyond the challenge interval.

Product, study and population: BPZE1 SUPER phase IIb trial, NCT05116241. Of 368 randomised children and adolescents aged 6–17 years with acellular-vaccine priming, 366 received vaccination [bpze1_super2026; bpze1_super_registry].
Measured endpoint or proposed assessment: BPZE1 alone and with Tdap induced nasal S-IgA responses, with preserved Tdap serum IgG responses during coadministration. The registered colonisation substudy has no results: investigational qPCR lacked sensitivity and cultures were not performed.
Use in the present analysis: Clinical support for the adolescent target population and comparison of standalone delivery with Tdap coadministration.
Quantities requiring separate estimation: Childhood acquisition and clearance effects, joint transmission protection with Tdap, and the duration of these effects.

Product, study and population: GamLPV dose and delivery study. Fifty adults aged 18–40 years were enrolled and 49 entered the final analysis [gamlpv_delivery2025].
Measured endpoint or proposed assessment: Serum and mucosal antibody responses and cellular responses after the first and second administrations, 60 days apart. A second dose increased antibody responses. Measured immune responses showed no significant difference between drops and spray delivery.
Use in the present analysis: Context for interpreting dosing and delivery assumptions across products.
Quantities requiring separate estimation: Clinical equivalence of drops and spray, protection after one versus two doses, completion of a two-dose course, and its delivery costs.

Product, study and population: GamLPV adult multicentre immunogenicity and phase III safety reports. Each describes 260 adults aged 18–65 years, with 210 assigned to vaccine and 50 to placebo, and two doses 60 days apart [gamlpv_immunogenicity2024; gamlpv_phase3_safety].
Measured endpoint or proposed assessment: Antibody responses increased after vaccination. After the second administration of the attenuated 4MKS vaccine strain, the median time to the qPCR DNA clearance threshold fell from 16 to 7 days. The safety report recorded no serious or severe adverse events.
Use in the present analysis: Human evidence relevant to clearance as a component of mucosal protection and to the development of a second intranasal product.
Quantities requiring separate estimation: Clearance of wild-type infection, viable bacterial shedding, infectiousness to contacts, clinical disease protection and protection duration.

Product, study and population: BPZE1 proposed phase III study IB-302P, described in a public GMO application published on 18 May 2026 [bpze1_phase3_application2026].
Measured endpoint or proposed assessment: Proposed comparison with Tdap in healthy adults, with wild-type challenge at 2–3 months or 12–14 months after vaccination and repeated post-challenge sampling. The application describes the design and contains no clinical results.
Use in the present analysis: Defines an empirical comparison relevant to the model's duration assumptions and the distinction between short-term and sustained colonisation protection.
Quantities requiring separate estimation: Observed protection at either interval, its translation to population transmission, and protection over several years.
